about.title: About Timezone Converter
about.description: The Timezone Converter helps you convert time between different time zones around the world. Perfect for scheduling international meetings, coordinating with global teams, or planning travel across time zones. Features real-time conversion with daylight saving time awareness, making it essential for business communications, event planning, and managing relationships across different geographical locations.

faq.q: Does the timezone converter handle daylight saving time automatically?
faq.a: Yes, our timezone converter automatically accounts for daylight saving time changes in all supported time zones throughout the year. The system updates automatically when DST begins and ends, ensuring accurate time conversions.

faq.q: How many time zones are supported by the converter?
faq.a: The timezone converter supports all major world time zones, including regional variations and historical time zone changes. This covers over 400 time zones worldwide with their specific UTC offsets and DST rules.

faq.q: Can I compare multiple time zones simultaneously?
faq.a: Yes, you can add multiple time zones to see the same time across different regions simultaneously. This is perfect for scheduling international meetings or coordinating with global teams across various time zones.

faq.q: What happens if a time zone changes its rules?
faq.a: Our timezone converter uses an updated time zone database that reflects current and historical time zone rules and changes. The system is regularly updated to handle any governmental changes to time zone policies.

faq.q: How accurate is the timezone conversion?
faq.a: The timezone converter is highly accurate, using the official IANA Time Zone Database. It accounts for all historical changes, current rules, and future scheduled changes to ensure precise time conversions.

faq.q: Can I use the converter for scheduling meetings across time zones?
faq.a: Absolutely! The timezone converter is perfect for scheduling international meetings. You can compare multiple time zones to find suitable meeting times that work for participants in different geographical locations.
